name: atlassian-twg-cli
description: Teamwork Graph CLI is Atlassian's agent-first interface to your entire work context: Jira issues, Confluence pages, Bitbucket PRs, along with your connected third-party data sources. Purpose-built for coding agents like Antigravity (terminal or desktop), and powered by Atlassian's context graph. Try: "draft a Jira issue from this PR and link it to the epic." Run /twg-setup after install to connect Atlassian Teamwork Graph CLI to Antigravity.
suggestedPrompts: Help me implement [JIRA-123]. Retrieve the requirements, acceptance criteria, and linked design decisions. Inspect this repository and propose an implementation plan before changing code.
Investigate [JIRA-123] in this repository. Find related bugs, previous fixes, and relevant technical decisions. Recommend a fix and the tests needed to verify it.
Review my current changes against [JIRA-123] and its linked specification. Flag missed requirements, conflicting decisions, and missing tests.
